# SYNESIS_E093 — Error

## Description

Repeated question `Q1` (first on line 2).

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

The question identifier `Q1` was already used on line 2.
  Each question needs a unique identifier in the project (case does not
  matter: `Q1` and `q1` are the same). Rename one of the two.
